grammar.title: Hedging: melunakkan pernyataan
grammar.explanation: Dalam negosiasi, pernyataan yang terlalu langsung bisa terdengar kasar. Lunakkan dengan 'it seems', 'might', 'a little', 'we'd prefer', atau ubah perintah menjadi pertanyaan. Pesannya tetap tegas, tapi nadanya profesional.
examples: It seems that the budget might be a little tight.
We'd prefer to keep the original scope.
That appears to be slightly higher than we expected.

common_mistake.wrong: Your price is too high. Lower it.
common_mistake.right: Your price seems a little higher than we expected. Is there any flexibility?

grammar.title: Reported speech untuk merangkum rapat
grammar.explanation: Saat melaporkan ucapan orang lain, tenses biasanya mundur satu langkah (will → would, can → could, present → past) dan keterangan waktu ikut berubah (tomorrow → the next day). Pertanyaan ya/tidak dilaporkan dengan 'whether' atau 'if'.
examples: The client said they needed the app by March.
She asked whether we could reduce the price.
They told us they would sign the following week.

common_mistake.wrong: He said that he will send the contract tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: He said that he would send the contract the next day.

reading.title: The power of the first number
reading.text: In negotiations, the first number mentioned often has a surprising amount of power. Psychologists call this the anchoring effect. Once a figure has been put on the table, both sides tend to adjust from it rather than think independently. In a well-known experiment, experienced estate agents were shown the same house but given different listing prices. Their valuations stayed remarkably close to whichever price they had seen first, even though most of them insisted that the listing price had not influenced them. For freelancers and agencies, the lesson is clear: it usually pays to make the first offer, provided it is ambitious but defensible. If the other side anchors first, negotiators are advised not to respond to the number directly. Instead, they might shift the conversation back to value, scope and deliverables before naming a figure of their own.

options: The first number influences later judgements

options: That the listing price had not influenced them

writing.prompt: Tulis email rangkuman setelah negosiasi dengan klien (Ms Tan). Rangkum apa yang disepakati, apa yang ditunda ke fase 2, dan langkah selanjutnya. Gunakan reported speech serta bahasa yang sopan tapi tegas.
checklist: Pembuka menyebut tujuan email (to summarise our call)
Reported speech minimal dua kali (You mentioned that ..., You asked whether ...)
Hedging untuk hal sensitif (It seems ..., We would prefer ...)
Langkah berikutnya dengan tenggat yang jelas
useful_phrases: I'm writing to summarise what we discussed.
After some discussion, we agreed on the following points:
It seems this would be possible if ...
Please let me know if I have misunderstood anything.
writing.model_answer:
Subject: Summary of today's call – mobile app project

Dear Ms Tan,

Thank you for your time this afternoon. I'm writing to summarise what we discussed, so that both teams share the same understanding before the contract is revised.

At the start of the call, you mentioned that our original quote was higher than your approved budget, and that the March launch date could not be moved. We explained that the price included three months of post-launch support, which we would prefer to keep, as it significantly reduces risk for your team.

After some discussion, we agreed on the following points:

1. The total price will be reduced by 10%.
2. The in-app chat feature will be moved to a second phase, which we will quote separately in April.
3. The launch date remains 15 March.
4. Post-launch support stays at three months.

You also asked whether we could share a clickable prototype earlier. It seems this would be possible if we receive the final brand guidelines by next Wednesday, so I would be grateful if your design team could send them by then.

Next steps: you said you would send the revised contract by Friday, and we will confirm the detailed timeline within two working days of signing.

Please let me know if I have misunderstood anything. Otherwise, we look forward to getting started.

Kind regards,
Bagus Athallah

speaking.focus: Nada sopan: intonasi lembut pada 'I'm afraid', bentuk lemah 'would' /wəd/, dan tekanan jelas pada angka serta kata kunci.

speaking.prompt: Situasi kerja: klien meminta tiga fitur tambahan tanpa menambah biaya atau tenggat. Tolak dengan sopan, jelaskan alasannya, lalu tawarkan dua alternatif (5 sampai 6 kalimat).
speaking.sample_answer: Thank you for sharing these ideas; they would definitely make the app stronger. I'm afraid we can't add all three features without changing the budget or the deadline, because each of them needs at least a week of development and testing. Bear in mind that rushing them could also put the March launch at risk. There are two options I'd suggest. We could add the most important feature now and move the other two to a second phase. Alternatively, if the launch date had some flexibility, we'd be willing to include all three for a small additional fee.

n1.them: Thanks for coming in. I'll be direct: your quote is about thirty percent above our budget.

tawarkan syarat: We'd be willing to ... if ...

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "That would be difficult at full scope, but we'd be willing to lower the price if we reduced the number of features."

n3.them: Which features would you suggest removing?

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "We could move the reporting dashboard to a second phase. Users won't need it during the first month."

n4.them: Hmm. Our CEO also wants the app live before the end of March. That's non-negotiable.
hints: setujui dengan syarat: That's achievable, provided ...
sebut apa yang kamu butuhkan dari klien

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "That's achievable, provided we get your feedback on each design within three working days."

n5.them: All right. If we meet you halfway on the price, do we have a deal?

fallback.feedback: Contoh: "I think we have a deal. I'll send you a summary today so we can update the contract."

end.them: Perfect. I look forward to receiving it. It's a pleasure doing business with you.
